parameters.name: Enable
parameters.description: Enables or disables this MQTT client identity entry.

parameters.name: Name
parameters.description: A unique, human-readable name for this MQTT client identity entry.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: A human-readable description of this MQTT client identity entry.

parameters.name: ClientID
parameters.description: The MQTT protocol-level Client Identifier for this client, sent in the CONNECT packet (see {{bibref|MQTT50|section 3.1.3.1}}). It uniquely identifies this client identity and can be used for matching ACL rules, either on its own or in conjunction with the {{param|Username}} from this entry.

parameters.name: Username
parameters.description: Username for this client. When {{param|Device.MQTT.Broker.{i}.AuthenticationMethod}} is {{enum|UsernamePassword|Device.MQTT.Broker.{i}.AuthenticationMethod}}, this username is used for authentication, matched against the username provided by the client. When certificate-based authentication is used (e.g., {{enum|CertViaCN|Device.MQTT.Broker.{i}.AuthenticationMethod}}), this username is matched against the username derived from the client's certificate for authorization purposes. If {{empty}}, this rule may apply to anonymous clients, provided {{param|Device.MQTT.Broker.{i}.AllowAnonymous}} is {{true}}.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.description: The password for this user, to be provided by the client. This parameter is only used for authentication when {{param|Device.MQTT.Broker.{i}.AuthenticationMethod}} is set to {{enum|UsernamePassword|Device.MQTT.Broker.{i}.AuthenticationMethod}}.

object.description: Configuration for an MQTT client identity, which represents an entry in an authorization table that the local broker uses to authorize incoming MQTT client connections. This is different from the {{object|##.Client}} object, which defines the credentials that a specific MQTT client instance on this device should use when connecting to an external or internal MQTT broker. {{object}} defines the credentials for a single client, which can be based on a {{param|ClientID}}, a {{param|Username}}/{{param|Password}} pair, or a certificate identity (which is not stored here but verified by the broker against these entries).
